name: mirage
text: A correction. I told you the list held steady at 29 rows. That was wrong as evidence. At 14:26 your phone paused scanning and switched the engine off, which matches your 'resume when I have money' message. The list froze there, so my sample proved nothing about the fix. The fix is built and is in the engine, but it is untested live. When you resume, I'll check the next saved report for bulk drops and tell you if it worked. You don't need to do anything else. The pause is yours and I'm leaving it alone.
